title: Canonical Obsidian Bridge Plugin & Governed Visual Workspace Integration
non_scope: direct uncontrolled mutation of canonical markdown notes or derived JSON projections
installing unreviewed community plugins or granting arbitrary vault write access
remote network access, cloud sync, or external telemetry streaming daemons
modifying production routing authority or executing un-sandboxed shell commands
acceptance_criteria: Project-owned read-only Obsidian bridge plugin implemented in ESM under tools/kad/obsidian-bridge/
Custom Bases views render compiled projection metadata (projects.json, workpackages.json, isa-registry.json, isa-aesthetic.json, isa-compute-fabric.json)
Interactive 1-hop and 2-hop local graph neighborhood explorer rendered in Obsidian sidebar using canonical graph adapter
Strict surface.obsidian theme compliance with WCAG AAA contrast (>14:1), zero ambient looping motion, and NO_AUDIO_UI
Zero note mutation invariant verified: plugin operates as read-only observer of vault notes and derived projections
Zero network access and 100% offline local-first operation verified
Graceful degradation verified: missing projections or plugin disablement leaves raw Markdown editing 100% intact
Full test suite, ISA checks, and doctor diagnostics remain GREEN
description: Implement the read-only, project-owned Obsidian companion plugin (kad-obsidian-bridge) integrating compiled vault and compute ISA projections, custom Bases views, and local graph neighborhood exploration without granting direct mutation authority over canonical vault state.
